description: Stamp text and images (logos, signature images, photos) onto specific pages of an existing PDF at exact positions. Coordinates are PDF points measured from the bottom-left corner of the page as the viewer sees it (1 inch = 72 pt; US Letter is 612 x 792), so stamps land upright on any page size or rotation. Text uses standard fonts (WinAnsi characters only: CJK and emoji fail with unsupported_characters) and can wrap to max_width. Images are PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB each and 10 distinct images per call (the PDF and all images together must stay under 4.5 MB), given as an https:// URL or a data:image/png;base64,... URI. Barcodes (QR, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13/8, UPC-A, ITF-14, Interleaved 2 of 5, GS1-128) are generated from a value and drawn as vector paths, so they scan at any print size (up to 25 per call). Use pdf_fill for fillable form fields and pdf_watermark for a diagonal stamp on every page. Returns the result inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified.

items.description: Stamps to draw, in order (later items draw on top).

background.description: type=barcode: optional hex fill behind the symbol; no quiet zone is added, so leave a margin

color.description: type=text or barcode: hex #rgb or #rrggbb, default #000000

error_correction.description: type=barcode, qrcode only: error correction level, default M

height.description: type=image or barcode: height in points

image.description: type=image: PNG or JPEG as an https:// URL or a data:image/png;base64,… URI

include_text.description: type=barcode: print the human-readable value under linear codes, default false

line_height.description: type=text: line spacing as a multiple of size, default 1.2

max_width.description: type=text: wrap words to this width in points

rotation.description: type=text: degrees counter-clockwise as the viewer sees it, default 0

size.description: type=text: font size in points, default 12

text.description: type=text: the text; \n starts a new line

value.description: type=barcode: data to encode; format rules apply (ean13 = 12 or 13 digits, gs1-128 = bracketed AIs like (01)09506000134352)

width.description: type=image or barcode: width in points. Images and 2D codes: give only width or height to keep the aspect ratio (2D codes default to 72 pt). Linear codes: a missing side keeps 1 pt per module and 1 inch tall

x.description: Points from the left edge. Text: left of the first line's baseline. Image or barcode: left edge.

y.description: Points from the bottom edge. Text: the first line's baseline. Image or barcode: bottom edge.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

name: pdf_edit

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Add text, images, a signature or a barcode/QR code to a PDF
